headline: Weekly creative read
intro: Five reads, one synthesis, a short list of what to make next. Sources are named at the bottom, and every line carries a label so a guess never looks like a fact.

key_points.title: One argument fills the account
key_points.body: **<n>%** of live ads make the same claim, and it is growing. Rivals mix three claims. The customers' own words ask a different question.
key_points.label: Verified

key_points.title: A rival's offer is scaling
key_points.body: Competitor A's entry offer climbed from rank **#<a>** to **#<b>** over <n> days of paid delivery. It looks funded, not tested.
key_points.label: Inferred

key_points.title: The strongest customer line is unused
key_points.body: The most repeated phrase in reviews appears in **<n>** of our ads. It names a situation the ads never show.
key_points.label: Verified

account.summary: Window: <dates>, <attribution window>. Source: ad-account export dated <date>.

dying.title: <Ad or concept name>
dying.detail: <spend> at <ROAS>; third variant of the same idea
dying.label: Verified

account.note: **Structural:** formats rotated but efficiency didn't move. <One sentence on who is under- or over-funded, with the numbers.>

competitors.summary: Rival A: <n> launches, <n>% promotional. Rival B: <n> launches. Rival C is dark: a coverage gap, not silence.

cards.title: Borrowed credibility
cards.body: Two rivals moved to endorsements in the same 30 days. **The trust fight is being won with names, not proof.**
cards.label: Verified

cards.title: Offer pressure
cards.body: Rival A's entry offer is scaling (<n> days). Rival B's top ad sells its line at <n>% off. **We shouldn't answer in kind.**
cards.label: Inferred

cards.title: Whitespace held
cards.body: Neither rival runs a proof-led ad. The one move worth borrowing is <a format>, which we have never run.
cards.label: Inferred

voice.summary: <n> reviews and <n> ad comments read, last 60 days. <Say which source is thin or old.>

items.note: The strongest repeated register on the account.
items.label: Verified

items.note: Rarer but hotter: <n> average rating when mentioned.
items.label: Verified

openings.summary: What is moving outside the account.

organic.title: Organic outliers (30 days)
organic.intro: The closest organic match to our approved angle:
organic.callout: **Do not chase:** <three formats that look hot but don't fit the brand>.

affinity.title: Affinity signals (public ad library, other categories)

items.text: **<Brand>**: rank 1 for <n> days. <The move, in a line>.
items.label: Verified

next.summary: Three concepts worth briefing. Each traces to a persona, an angle and the evidence above.

judging.title: 20 concepts, 60 blind verdicts, 8 survivors
judging.summary: Optional. Three independent judges per concept, none seeing the others. Survival needs 7 or more from at least 2 of 3.

judges.name: Judge A: track record
judges.text: The account's all-time winners, tags and failure patterns. Asks: has this worked here before?

judges.name: Judge B: customer
judges.text: This week's customer-language memo only. Asks: does it sound like what buyers actually say?

judges.name: Judge C: assassin
judges.text: Nothing but the concept, told to kill it, default to no.

judging.died: <The patterns that died and why, in two lines. Link the full verdicts file.>

limits: No ad-account export this week: the account section is marked data-limited until one is saved to `source-pulls/`.
Ad library ranks are impressions inside a start-date cohort, not sales.

sources.name: Public ad library
sources.what: rivals' live ads, read in the browser
